title: CRI runtimes: image lockfile generation and kubelet preload + vendored crictl
author: Evan Morales
body: Summary: Add deterministic image lockfile generation for offline registries, kubelet preload manifests for multiple CRI runtimes, and vendor a small crictl binary to enable image unpacking on systems that lack docker. Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in heavily regulated on-prem and air-gapped environments commonly run non-Docker CRI runtimes (containerd, CRI-O) and struggle with two problems: 1) producing a reproducible, ordered image index suitable for OCI registry mirrors, and 2) ensuring node-level preload of images when kubelet/registry bootstrap happens in disconnected sites. This PR introduces a deterministic image lockfile format, a kubelet preloader generator that emits system-specific manifests for containerd and CRI-O, and an opt-in vendored crictl utility to perform image unpack and snapshot setup on bootstrap nodes. Changes in this PR: Commit summary: 1) Add lockfile generator CLI (pkg/airgap/lockfile) that computes ordered image lists with canonical sha256 digests and optional checksum-alias entries for mirror verification. 2) Implement kubelet-preload generator (pkg/airgap/preload) producing CRI-O Systemd units and containerd tar+ctr import wrappers. 3) Vendor crictl binary and small wrapper script (tools/vendor/crictl and tools/vendor/cri-helpers.sh) with verification via included signatures. 4) Integrate lockfile output into the airgap bundle pipeline and update bundle indexer to include lockfile.digest and layout metadata. 5) Add e2e tests for preload on both containerd and CRI-O (test/airgap/preload_integration_test.go) and unit tests for lockfile determinism. 6) Documentation updates and examples (docs/airgap/lockfile.md and examples/airgap/cri-preload/README.md). Files changed (high level): docs/airgap/lockfile.md - new operational guide and schema examples. pkg/airgap/lockfile/generator.go - deterministic sorting and canonicalization logic. pkg/airgap/preload/preloader.go - runtime detection and manifest templates. tools/vendor/crictl - vendored small crictl binary shim (sha256 checksum included in package). tools/vendor/cri-helpers.sh - helper script to import and unpack images. cmd/airgap-bundle/main.go - integrate lockfile generation and index entry. test/airgap/preload_integration_test.go - new integration tests using kind configured with containerd and cri-o runners. examples/airgap/cri-preload/ - sample manifests and step-by-step guides. CI and tests: CircleCI/Buildkite matrix updated to run a lightweight preload integration test using KinD with containerd and a simulated CRI-O environment. Unit tests cover lockfile determinism and schema compatibility. There was an initial flaky test in preload integration on containerd that timed out during image import; fixed by adding a retry loop and a shorter watch timeout. All checks are green on the final run. Review conversation summary: Priya Nair: "Very helpful for on-prem customers; please make sure checksum verification is optional by default for older mirrors." Response (author): "Made checksum verification opt-in via --verify-checksums flag; default remains permissive to avoid blocking older registries." Ben Thompson: "We should avoid shipping large binaries in the repo, can we vendor a minimal static crictl or provide an automated fetch?" Response: "We vendored a tiny statically linked helper (sub-5MB) and added a build target to emit checksums; also added an option to skip vendored binary and fetch from a signed blob store during bundle creation." Lucas Romero: "Test coverage looks good; one nit about error messages when the manifest template fails rendering." Response: "Updated the template errors to include the node id and runtime; added a unit test to validate error path." Merge decision and method: Merged via squash-merge after all reviewers approved and CI passed. Rollout notes: This change is backward compatible. Bundles generated without a lockfile will still install using legacy image lists; when bundles include lockfile.digest the installer will prefer the lockfile for verification and preload ordering. Operational guidance: Operators should regenerate lockfiles after any image set changes and include the lockfile.digest in the bundle metadata. For air-gapped installs that use CRI-O, enable the cri-o preload via the feature toggle in the installer config (installer.features.cri_preload: true). Release notes: "Add deterministic image lockfile and CRI runtime preload support for on-prem/air-gapped installers. Optional vendored crictl helper for image import. Improves reliability of node bootstrap in disconnected environments." Related work: Follow-up PR will add Terraform module support for automating bundle upload to private OCI registries and add a KMS-backed signature verification step during bundle apply. Linear tickets: ENG-2481 (lockfile design), INF-793 (cri-preload implementation).
